name: lobby-create
prepare: (() => { const want = ["创建房间","建房间","新建房间"]; const vis = (el) => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && getComputedStyle(el).visibility !== 'hidden'; }; const all = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, [role=tab], a')].filter(vis); const hit = all.find((el) => want.some((w) => (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').startsWith(w) || el.textContent.trim() === w)); if (hit) hit.click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r(hit ? 'clicked' : 'none'), 1500)); })()
